# VeriShield AI

> VeriShield AI is a web app that checks documents, images, video, text and links for signs of tampering or fraud, and keeps a SHA-256 fingerprinted record of every verdict in a personal vault.

Verdicts come from rule-based checks on file structure, metadata and wording, plus an optional AI-image detection model. They are indicators, not legal proof.

## Pages

- [Home](https://verishield-ai-web.vercel.app/): What the app does, how it works and how to read a verdict.
- [URL Intel](https://verishield-ai-web.vercel.app/url-check): Check whether a shop, ad or social link looks safe. No account needed.
- [Forensic Workbench](https://verishield-ai-web.vercel.app/workbench): Scan an image, video, PDF or pasted text. Requires sign-in.
- [Sign in](https://verishield-ai-web.vercel.app/sign-in): Sign in or create a free account.

## What it detects

- Images: AI-generator and editing-tool metadata (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, C2PA), missing camera provenance, standard AI output sizes.
- PDFs: structural integrity and editing-tool signatures.
- Text: known phishing and AI-boilerplate phrasing.
- Links: scam keywords, lookalike domains, match against known platforms.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/lalit71718-bit/verishield-ai): Source code, setup instructions and API reference.
